RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: 5

Both you and the successful candidate are women, meaning sex was not a differentiating factor. An all-female panel selecting a woman over another woman provides no credible basis for a sex-discrimination claim. 

Leadership positions in banking frequently prioritize regulatory affairs, supervisory interaction, and commercial governance over pure statistical depth. The panel almost certainly decided that the other candidate’s regulatory background was a better fit for this specific head-level mandate. 

Raising gender bias under these facts is unsubstantiated and could severely damage your professional reputation. Instead, send a polite follow-up requesting constructive interview feedback to help strengthen your profile for future executive appointments.
